hypothesis: The raw-only auditor rejects a packet whose source binding has been rebound in both case and event, or whose SOFT_CHANGED guard receipt contradicts the required authority/decision flags.
pass_criterion: Control is accepted; the two-location binding rebind and each contradictory SOFT_CHANGED semantic-flag mutation are rejected by the frozen target auditor. The frozen v2 guard contract defines SOFT_CHANGED as keep_existing_policy=true, requires_new_decision=false, grants_input_authority=false, may_only_preserve_or_reduce_existing_authority=true, semantic_change_identified=true, task_success_verified=false.
failure_criterion: Any corrupted packet is accepted by the frozen target auditor.
costs: Local CPU only; five finite packet audits; no container, WSLc, model, game, GUI, GPU, CUDA, network call by the experiment, or user-input effect.
unknowns: Whether production has an independent binding envelope that prevents a rebound packet.
Whether other consumers validate the v30 guard semantic flags before projection.
Any live planner decision or survival effect.
retry_policy: One frozen candidate packet-generation invocation; one target-auditor subprocess per case; no retries or replacements.
